description: For jobsite safety, this request form records task hazards, competent-person controls, PPE, access protection, emergency contacts, and weather limits. Its supporting evidence includes pre-task briefing record, inspection observations, control photos, permits, and corrective-action verification.

Complete the applicable handoff for competent-person release, corrective-action closure, crew acknowledgment, and next-review trigger.
